digest.component_or_area: transition request / close-reason and force plumbing
propositions: Close-reason and force admission rules are implemented independently across three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with inconsistent handling: CLI refuses inadmissible reason (exit 1) while library silently discards it (returns 0), and MCP does not expose reason parameter at all.

The placeholder string '(no reason given)' is produced at five code sites across three files, with one datum traveling under three different names (force_reason, force_close, force_close_reason), violating the rule that a single constant should be produced in exactly one place.

A bare --force flag on a reason-required class must remain accepted; normalizing empty reason to placeholder only if that normalization occurs before the refusal check to avoid false rejection at txn.py:232.
The normalized placeholder must never reach close_disposition.verdict, as an empty reason fails closed there and a normalized placeholder would convert an UNJUSTIFIED disposition to SIGNED.
MCP transition_ticket must gain reason parameter by constructing the shared TransitionRequest object, flipping the strict-xfail write-parity test from fail to pass and removing the xfail marker.
